letter.title: a little letter, just for you
letter.body:
Hey Hena,

Okay, first of all, happy birthdayyy!! 🎂

I was going to send a normal birthday message, but then I thought... why not do something a little different this time? So yeah, here's this little thing I made haha.

I hope today gives you plenty of reasons to smile. Have some good food, enjoy your day, take way too many pictures, and save a little cake for later. 😭

And seriously, I hope this year brings you some really good moments — the kind you remember even after a long time.

Anyway, no long speech today. It's your day, so enjoy it properly.

Happy Birthday again, Hena 🌸✨

— Debjeet

Some gifts are created with time, patience, and care.
